title: Randomizer Block
description: This Mod adds a Randomizer Block that can give a random output from 1 - 15.
body:
## Randomizer Block
### What this mod adds
This mod adds a _block_ called the **Randomizer Block.** This _block_ will output a signal strength between 1 and 15 randomly.

### How to use it
**The Randomizer Block** works by taking input from the _side_ with _**one**_ dot on it:

![The side with one dot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd7a57f27f4c2b9ec8668b7d77fb2b949dae4592_0.webp)

And giving an **_output_** on the _side_ with _**six dots**_:

![The side with six dots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c75b14d7cb3606bdaabcb3248a2f21a8f303aa03_0.webp)

### How it works
When it gets an _input_, it will **immidiatly** output a _random_ signal strength between **1 and 15.** This signal is **_only_** turned **_off_** if the block is **_removed_** or the block **_no longer gets power._**

### Crafting
The _recipe_ for the **Randomizer Block** is:
![Crafting recipe for the Randomizer Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0ea4467eee15f236a4f5907139229db4557d9fc9.png)

### Why use it?
This block is perfect for:
- Minigames that need a random event
- Casino machines
- Puzzle maps
- Making a dice
- Adventure maps
